# Liangchao Deng (邓良超)

> Postdoctoral Researcher, Shenzhen Institute of China Agricultural University · Shenzhen, China. Research program: making plant science measurable with AI, from sensing crops to designing crops.

Toward high, stable, and resource-efficient crop production under climate change, my research turns satellite–UAV–ground 3D observations into interpretable crop physiological states and, by coupling structure–radiation–photosynthesis–growth processes with data assimilation, builds verifiable, predictive, and intervenable crop digital twins that provide a mechanistic basis for the coordinated design of genotype × environment × management (G×E×M). With multi-source observation and AI, I make the state of the crop system observable, its mechanisms interpretable, its future projectable, and its decision risk quantifiable.

Profiles: [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5194-0655) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=u3GFRMQAAAAJ&view_op=list_works) · [GitHub](https://github.com/smiler488)

## Research layers

- Layer I · Digitize (DIG): Physical to digital crop: imaging, 3D reconstruction and sensing turn a real crop into quantified traits.
- Layer II · Understand (UND): Digital to explainable crop: coupling structure, radiation and photosynthesis with scientific AI.
- Layer III · Predict (PRE): Toward a predictive crop: projecting growth under environment and management scenarios.
- Layer IV · Design (DES): Toward a designed crop: inverse design over genotype, environment and management.

## Research projects

- [Predicting leaf BRDF from phenotypic traits](https://smiler488.github.io/research/brdf-traits): Leaf directional reflectance can be predicted from measurable traits, and the resulting differences in leaf optics change how light is distributed inside a simulated canopy. [UND]
- [MCTP: a multi-modal crop phenotyping data processing platform](https://smiler488.github.io/research/mctp-workspace): One desktop platform processes hyperspectral, LiDAR, RGB and thermal phenotyping data with a shared interface, interactive parameter tuning, batch processing and structured exports. [DIG]

## Publications and software

- [Leaf Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF) Prediction with Phenotypic Traits in Four Species: Development of a Novel Measuring and Analyzing Framework](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.plaphe.2025.100135): Deng, L., Yu, L. X., Mao, L., Wang, Y., Guo, X., Wang, M., Zhang, Y., Song, Q., Zhu, X.-G. (2025). Plant Phenomics. Peer-reviewed article. DOI 10.1016/j.plaphe.2025.100135. [UND]
- [Digital Plant Phenotyping Platform (v25.0)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17544584): Deng, L. (2025). Zenodo. Research software. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17544584. [DIG]

## Browser tools (App Lab)

Free tools that run in the browser; data stays on the visitor's device unless an AI feature is explicitly used with the visitor's own key.

- [Device Sensor Recorder](https://smiler488.github.io/app/sensor): Capture phone orientation, leaf inclination, location and solar geometry as timestamped field records, then export a research-ready CSV. [DIG]
- [Land Surveyor](https://smiler488.github.io/app/land-survey): Build a field boundary from manual coordinates or device location and estimate area in square metres, hectares and mu. [DIG]
- [Irrigation Layout Designer](https://smiler488.github.io/app/irrigation-designer): Check a drip-irrigation block: lateral, submain and mainline losses, pressure at the farthest subunit and emitter flow variation, with a validated model. [DES]
- [NASA POWER Weather Downloader](https://smiler488.github.io/app/weather): Select a location and date range, retrieve NASA POWER agrometeorological data and preview or download clean CSV results. [PRE]
- [CCO Waylines Builder](https://smiler488.github.io/app/cco): Turn KML field boundaries into previewable DJI-compatible CCO wayline packages with configurable flight and camera settings. [DIG]
- [Biological Sample Quantifier](https://smiler488.github.io/app/image): Open the hosted analysis workspace to quantify biological samples from uploaded or captured images and export measurements. [DIG]
- [Root Image Preprocessor](https://smiler488.github.io/app/root-processor): Prepare root scans with polygon regions, background cleanup, high-pass enhancement and precise manual corrections. [DIG]
- [Stereo Vision Workspace](https://smiler488.github.io/app/stereo): Rectify a calibrated side-by-side stereo stream, compute metric depth by block matching and export depth in millimetres. [DIG]
- [Calibration Targets Generator](https://smiler488.github.io/app/targets): Generate printable checkerboards and segmented circular markers at exact millimetre sizes, with fit checks and PDF export. [DIG]
- [AI Data Visualizer](https://smiler488.github.io/app/ai-data-visualizer): Load a table and chart it from the full data; an optional AI provider suggests the chart, and group comparisons run ANOVA and Tukey tests locally. [UND]
- [AI Journal Selector](https://smiler488.github.io/app/journal-selector): Compare a manuscript abstract with configurable journal criteria using the AI provider and API key you choose.
- [Multimodal AI Solver](https://smiler488.github.io/app/solver): Ask with text, camera or screen capture and send the prompt to the visual AI model and API provider you configure.
- [Encrypted Note](https://smiler488.github.io/app/cloudnote): Encrypt a text note in the browser, share it through a URL fragment or keep a password-protected copy in local storage.
- [Research Maze](https://smiler488.github.io/app/maze): A compact canvas experiment in procedural maze generation, keyboard and touch input, movement trails and local scores.

## Research notes

- [PhenoHUB: A Mobile Toolkit for Digital Plant Phenotyping](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/phenohub-wechat-miniapp): A WeChat Mini Program for plant phenotyping fieldwork: leaf-angle and land-area measurement, site weather, image analysis, AI-assisted charting and data management in one mobile toolkit. [DIG]
- [Botanical Extract AI Pro: Zero-Shot Plant Background Removal with Multimodal Models](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/botanical-extract-ai-pro): A web application and batch pipeline that removes plant-image backgrounds without task-specific training, using a multimodal image model with a structured prompt, aspect-ratio matching and file-signature format detection. [DIG]
- [MCTP: A Multi-Modal Crop Phenotyping Data Processing Platform](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/mctp-unified-phenotyping-platform): A desktop platform that processes hyperspectral, LiDAR, RGB and thermal phenotyping data with one interface, interactive parameter tuning, batch processing and structured exports. [DIG]
- [Predicting Leaf BRDF from Phenotypic Traits](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/brdf-paper): A measuring and analysis framework that predicts leaf BRDF parameters from phenotypic traits in four species, combining directional spectroscopy, Cook–Torrance fitting, ensemble learning and canopy ray tracing (Plant Phenomics, 2025). [UND]
- [Quantifying Seeds, Leaves and Other Plant Samples from Images with Python](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/local-image-quantification-tutorial): A local OpenCV method that segments separated plant samples on a uniform background and measures size, shape and colour in calibrated units, with an overlay for every image. [DIG]
- [Single-Image 3D Plant Reconstruction with 3D Generative AI, Evaluated against SfM](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/generative-ai-3d-plant-reconstruction): Generating 3D cotton plants from single photographs with 3D generative AI and evaluating them organ by organ against multi-view SfM reconstructions of the same plants. [DIG]
- [UAV 3D Crop Phenotyping: Cross-Circular Oblique Acquisition, SfM and CanopyPC](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/uav-3d-crop-phenotyping): A UAV workflow for plot-level 3D crop phenotyping: Cross-Circular Oblique flight design, SfM reconstruction, canopy point-cloud processing with CanopyPC, and machine-learning models of crop traits. [DIG]
- [Root Quantify: Interactive Root Image Preprocessing in Python](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/root-quantify): An interactive OpenCV tool that turns raw root scans and photographs into clean binary images through polygon ROI selection, illumination correction, thresholding and brush-based correction, ready for root-trait software. [DIG]
- [Canopy Photosynthesis Modeling from 3D Plant Reconstruction](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/canopy-photosynthesis-modeling-en): A modular model that reconstructs crop plants from multi-view images, assembles a triangle-facet canopy, simulates its light distribution by ray tracing, and integrates leaf photosynthesis to canopy carbon gain. [UND, PRE]
- [DJI P4 Multispectral to Plot-Level Traits with WebODM and QGIS](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/dji-p4m-webodm-qgis-workflow): Processing DJI P4 Multispectral imagery into radiometrically documented orthomosaics in WebODM, checking bands in QGIS, and extracting plot-level vegetation indices and texture features. [DIG]
- [3D Reconstruction of Potted Cotton by Turntable Photogrammetry](https://smiler488.github.io/blog/growth-chamber-cotton-3d): A growth-chamber protocol that reconstructs potted cotton plants from two-elevation turntable video with structure from motion, with scale control, colour correction and accuracy assessment. [DIG]
